name: Tsunami

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A wall of water up to 300 feet long and high and 50 feet thick: Str save, 6d10 Bludgeoning, half on a success.
text: At the start of each of your later turns the wall moves 50 feet away from you, carrying creatures in it; Huge or smaller creatures it holds or reaches make a Strength save or take 5d10 Bludgeoning (once per round), then the wall loses 50 feet of height and 1d10 of damage, ending at 0 height. Swimming in it takes a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check each turn.
